svg.aria-label: Two levels in LIMO. At the top, 14 small boxes, one per participant from cba to wpa, each labelled 1st level, with many thin trial curves turning into two short bars, beta animal and beta distractor. Arrows lead down to one wide box, 2nd level: paired test across participants, which ends in a small channels by time image with a few coloured patches marked significant clusters. Illustrative, no data.
